steps.name: setup
steps.instruction: Place two flasks on the desk — one with a GREEN label and one with a YELLOW label.
steps.detect: Two flasks visible on desk: one green-labeled, one yellow-labeled.
steps.success: Both flasks are on the desk. Ready to begin.
errors: Only one flask visible — place the second flask on the desk.
No flasks visible — please place both flasks on the desk.

steps.name: bring_baking_soda
steps.instruction: Bring the baking soda to the desk. It is in a yellow box labeled 'Pure Baking Soda'.
steps.detect: A yellow box labeled 'Pure Baking Soda' is visible on or near the desk, alongside the two flasks.
steps.success: Baking soda is on the desk.
errors: I don't see the baking soda yet — look for a yellow box labeled 'Pure Baking Soda'.

steps.name: pour_baking_soda
steps.instruction: Pour the baking soda into the GREEN flask.
steps.detect: Person is pouring or has poured white powder from the yellow box into the green-labeled flask. Pouring is considered when the person is holding with their hand the baking soda and is pointing it to the opening of the flask.
steps.success: Baking soda is in the green flask.
errors: That's the yellow flask — pour into the GREEN flask instead.
Pour the baking soda into the flask, not onto the desk.

steps.name: remove_baking_soda
steps.instruction: Put the baking soda box away — remove it from the desk.
steps.detect: The yellow 'Pure Baking Soda' box is no longer visible. Only the two flasks remain.
errors: The baking soda box is still on the desk — please remove it.

steps.name: bring_vinegar
steps.instruction: Bring the vinegar to the desk.
steps.detect: A bottle of vinegar is visible on or near the desk, alongside the two flasks.
errors: I don't see the vinegar yet — bring the vinegar bottle to the desk.

steps.name: pour_vinegar
steps.instruction: Pour the vinegar into the YELLOW flask.
steps.detect: Person is pouring or has poured liquid from the vinegar bottle into the yellow-labeled flask. This step is considered completed when the person holds a bottle (vinegar) with their hand and is getting it close to the top opening of the yellow flask (beggining of pouring).
steps.success: Vinegar is in the yellow flask.
errors: That's the green flask — pour into the YELLOW flask instead.
Pour the vinegar into the flask, not onto the desk.

steps.name: observe_reaction
steps.instruction: Pour the contents of the green flask into the yellow flask and observe the reaction.
steps.detect: Person is pouring from the green flask into the yellow flask, or fizzing/bubbling is visible in the yellow flask. This step is considered completed when the person holds the green flask with their hand and is getting it close to the top opening of the yellow flask.
steps.success: Reaction complete! You should see fizzing and bubbling as CO2 is released.
errors: Pour the GREEN flask contents into the YELLOW flask — not the other way around.

steps.name: done
steps.success: Great job! The experiment is finished.
